_about: Shorter names the news uses for a holding, by ticker, matched beside its registered name (analysis/company_names.py, analysis/parsing.title_matches_company). The displayed name stays the registered one. Hand-picked: add a form when a holding's name is longer than headlines write it. The run log names holdings found in their own news only by ticker; where the ticker is the name the news uses (BHEL), it is listed here as the form. A form must be capitalised in a headline as it is here, so ordinary words in it ('Indian Hotels') do not match a sentence about hotels.
